title: Create a separate component for Saved for Later page, remove dependency on ListDetails/useWishlists
path_reason: User-directed FAST. Default routing would have been FULL (shared-component regression surface: list-details.vue also serves the wishlist page, and the ticket comment asks to verify both pages). Compensated by folding the wishlist regression into the checklist (AC7) and the regression scope.

cross_run_reconciliation.why_relevant: Both ran on the SAME theme build as this ticket (2.55.0-pr-2418-cf47), so their failures coexist with VCST-4855 and had to be checked for attribution.
cross_run_reconciliation.conclusion: ZERO of the 8 FAILs is attributable to VCST-4855. The PR's blast radius is the SFL page component, the list-details props, and the savedForLater fragment; every FAIL below is either a backend/xAPI defect proven without any theme involvement, a test-case defect, or an unrelated element.
cross_run_reconciliation.verdict_impact: none - VCST-4855 stays PASS WITH NOTES

attribution_evidence.weakness_acknowledged: Both source runs executed on the SAME theme (pr-2418), so neither provided a before/after comparison. Attribution initially rested on diff scope alone, which is inference, not proof. Two hard checks were added to close that gap.
attribution_evidence.check_1_runtime_document_scope: The PR's types.ts changes 20 lines. Exactly FIVE runtime documents changed, all saved-for-later: GetSavedForLaterDocument, MoveToSavedForLaterDocument, MoveFromSavedForLaterDocument, SavedForLaterLineItemFragmentDoc, SavedForLaterListFragmentDoc (expected - the fragment gained availabilityData + properties and is embedded in the query and both move mutations). Verified ABSENT from the entire PR diff: AddCoupon, AddOrUpdateCartShipment, ClearCart, ChangeFullCartItemsQuantity, AddItemsCart, AddItemCart, GetShortCart, GetFullCart, MergeCart, MoveWishlistItem, GetWishlist, AddWishlistItem. So no cart and no wishlist operation is touched by this PR at all.
attribution_evidence.check_2_ab_against_a_build_without_the_p: BUG_007_004 was re-tested on vcst-qa, which pins theme 2.55.0-pr-2412 (does NOT contain VCST-4855). The inert dialog reproduces IDENTICALLY there: List name disabled, Description disabled, save button disabled AND unlabelled. Evidence: screenshots/AB-BUG007004-inert-dialog-on-pr2412-WITHOUT-the-PR.png. This is a direct before/after observation, not an inference - the defect predates the PR.

check_3_own_live_reproduction.why: The BUG_029_001 and WISH-015 conclusions initially rested on the earlier run's artifacts plus diff analysis - not on this session's own live execution. Both were therefore reproduced independently here, directly against vcptcore-qa xAPI (no browser, no theme in the path).
check_3_own_live_reproduction.BUG_029_001_dual_cart: REPRODUCED. cart query -> bd366533-29de-4311-8d65-efeb4d54858d (4 items, subTotal 12,951,560). addItem sent WITHOUT cartId -> resolved 8ccba96f-afd4-4fea-b96d-d6477f4918de (3 items), errors[] EMPTY. Same two cart ids the earlier run reported, and the stranded guest items are still present in the hidden cart (OGT-14787676 x3, YHJ-60756491 x1). Probe item removed afterwards; hidden cart restored to its prior two lines. Because this is a pure GraphQL call, the theme (and therefore this PR) cannot be the cause - the SERVER resolves a different cart aggregate for a cartId-less mutation.
check_3_own_live_reproduction.WISH-015_moveWishlistItem: REPRODUCED, and the trigger is now CHARACTERIZED - a finding that goes beyond the original report. First attempt with an in-stock product did NOT reproduce (moved correctly, src 0 / dest 1), which initially looked like a non-reproduction. Re-running with the exact product from the failing run (ALCE0128 / 0b6297e8) DID reproduce: errors[] EMPTY, dest itemsCount 0, src itemsCount 0 - item destroyed. Confirmed 2/2 vs 2/2: OOS products ALCE0128 and 5999086456519 (b6dc4971) are both DESTROYED; in-stock products RJU-80089342 (f1637322) and LBL-10496635 (9c0d0092) both move correctly. The two product records are identical on productType/hasVariations/isConfigurable/minQuantity/maxQuantity/isActive/isBuyable/availableQuantity and differ ONLY on availabilityData.isAvailable + isInStock. CONCLUSION: moveWishlistItem silently destroys the line item when the product is OUT OF STOCK, returning HTTP 200 with an empty errors[]. Still entirely unrelated to VCST-4855 (moveWishlistItem is absent from the PR diff and is a different mutation from moveFromSavedForLater), but this is a sharper root cause for whoever fixes it. All throwaway AGENT-TEST wishlists were deleted afterwards (account back to 0 lists).

per_defect_confidence.BUG_029_001_dual_cart: HIGH - the failing mutations (AddCoupon / AddOrUpdateCartShipment / addItem) are absent from the diff, and the re-check probe ran directly against GraphQL with no browser and no theme code in the path, so a theme-side document change cannot make the SERVER resolve two different cart aggregates. Note the PR does change MoveTo/MoveFromSavedForLater, which are cart-affecting - but only their selection set grew (availabilityData/properties); the command variables including cartId are unchanged, and neither mutation is the one the probe used.
per_defect_confidence.WISH-015_moveWishlistItem: HIGH - moveWishlistItem is a DIFFERENT mutation from moveFromSavedForLater (the one the PR touched). MoveWishlistItem is absent from the diff, and the case was executed runner-native via the graphql-runner, which sends its own query and never loads theme code.
per_defect_confidence.BUG_007_004_inert_list_settings_dialog: HIGH - proven pre-existing by the pr-2412 A/B above. Mechanically consistent: the PR removed only a v-if render guard plus the hideSettings/kind props, two emits and two kind branches; the settings button's click handler and the props it passes to the modal are untouched, and a removed render guard cannot disable a dialog's fields. Also note the dialog is populated with the correct list name, so the disabled state is not a failed-to-load symptom.

Deterministic PROBE-dual-cart re-FAILED: NOT fixed by Customer 3.1021.0 org-resolution rewrite, same two cart ids, stranded items still in the hidden cart.
